name: Authelia
description: Authentication and authorization layer: put every app behind one login with 2FA, SSO and fine-grained access rules. Headless reverse-proxy companion.
compose:
services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.http_port}}:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
    restart: unless-stopped
